epics.sixSigmaMetric: Decrease container startup failures due to unresolvable minio tag from 100% to 0%.
requirements: R1: Update the MinIO Docker image tag to a resolvable version.

slices.title: Update MinIO Docker Image Tag
slices.jtbd: When implementing the MinIO docker image tag fix for this epic, I want to replace the invalid tag with a valid one, so that the container starts without error.
slices.acceptanceCriteria:
Given the docker-compose.yml file,
When checking the MinIO service configuration,
Then it must use a valid and resolvable Docker image tag.
Given the updated configuration,
When executing docker compose up,
Then the MinIO container pulls and starts without 'not found' errors.
slices.sixSigmaMetric: Reduce Docker image pull errors for MinIO from 1 to 0.
